The main takeaway from our work is that
prenatal FISH studies should be considered in discordant cases to confirm the results and to determine the origin of the discordant karyotype.
prenatal diagnosis should be performed on both short-term and long-term cultures of chorionic villi, because the latter may reveal a karyotype different from that found in the former.
